subject: Tags leave the Wiki node namespace and ride the SourcePool; ingest reads sources; corpus skips are disclosed
result: Followed up tui-merge-train-closed-main-carries-2026-09-08's open question (3), 'owner decision on what counts as taggable'. The question rested on a false premise. VERIFIED: the claim '291 records, zero declaring tags' is true of the record population and wrong about the corpus. 256 other files under Work/O-I/Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/symbolon already carried an authored hierarchical tag vocabulary — 246x epi-logos/antikythera-essay, 133 source-bank/* on bibliography pages, 84 argument-map/* on register/reference pages. select_ingestable_records gated on record_id and reported every other file as one integer (436), so that vocabulary was walked past in silence; the prior session then authored a synthetic 36-record test set against a corpus that already had one. WHAT WAS BUILT (crates/aikit-core/src/knowledge_ingest.rs, knowledge_navigation.rs, knowledge_source_pool.rs; crates/aikit-cli/src/wiki.rs, cli.rs, app/knowledge.rs): (1) The wiki:node:tag/* node namespace and its 'tagged' edges are GONE. Tags were a second tag facility with first-declarer-wins provenance, no vocabulary discipline, unsanitised interpolation into ref strings, and no relation to SourceBinding::tags — the one tag carrier every SourcePool provider already reads. Tags now compile into SourceMaterial. (2) Ingest reads two populations: records (record_id) compile to curated nodes; source pages (source_id) compile to SourcePool bindings and never to nodes. Markdown links into the bibliography now resolve as citations into source_refs rather than dying as unresolved links. (3) A record's effective tags are its own plus those of every source it cites — vocabulary read off the register and bibliography, not generated from record_type/register. (4) select_ingestable_records now NAMES every file carrying corpus metadata without an identity (skipped_unaddressable) and only counts genuinely inert prose (skipped_inert). This disclosure is what surfaced 36 canonical A-/C-series records missing record_id. (5) knowledge_navigation.rs:286 passed &[] as the tag filter — the single production call to SourcePoolProvider::search. A 'tag:<value>' query term is now lifted out and passed through; a provider that cannot filter by tag is disclosed and skipped, never silently answering the broader question. (6) 'aikit wiki ingest' writes SourcePool material as discoverable corpus-NNN.json shards (default <wiki-stem>.sources/, or --source-pool DIR), sharded at 1 MiB because Knowledge discovery skips files over 4 MiB. (7) Discovery identifies SourceMaterial structurally before the okf-wiki/v1 content sniff; a corpus body that mentions the profile was being reported as malformed Wiki material on every search. MEASURED ON THE REAL CORPUS (727 files): records 291->327, sources 0->301, opaque skip count 436 -> 88 inert + 11 named, unresolved links 2338->1274, tag nodes 15->0, tagged edges 108->0, SourcePool bindings 0->628, tag vocabulary 15 synthetic -> 153 authored, tagged bindings 36->517. 'aikit knowledge search tag:source-bank/jung' returns A13/C33/C34/C35/C36 — records found by a tag they never declared, inherited from the bibliography they stand on. BKMR: the integration is real and was never bypassed at the adapter — BkmrSourcePoolProvider::rebuild loads material with its tags and search passes --tags. What was bypassed was upstream: nothing put the corpus's tags into any pool, and the query surface never passed a filter. Both are fixed. On this machine bkmr is 6.5.0 against a 7.6.7 conformance target and exposes no --db selector, so surface_reason correctly withholds it and tags run through NativeSourcePoolProvider, which implements the identical tag contract. That degradation is disclosed, not silent. CORPUS (its own repo, Antykathera-Essay-Work): the 36-record test set was removed via its sha-guarded manifest (36 removed, 0 skipped, 0 records now carry test tags). 159 files gained the identity they already had: record_id on 36 A-/C-series records whose id is their own filename prefix in an otherwise complete series, and source_id on 123 register/reference/map pages carrying argument-map/* with no identity (stem, or parent-stem where a stem is not unique). Nothing was invented; no file gained more than one line. TESTS: 696 workspace tests pass. Ingest unit tests rewritten around the new contract (tags in material, not nodes; source binding and tag inheritance; unmaterialised citation disclosed; metadata-carrying files named). Navigation gains a tag-filter test. 18 CLI wiki_commands tests pass. The one failure, mux_install::the_installed_alt_a_opens_the_real_surface_and_ctrl_t_switches_modes, fails identically on a stashed tree — pre-existing, tmux-environment, not this change. PRODUCT-GROUND: reconciled the 5 capabilities this change touches (wiki-write, knowledge-navigation, projectcentral, gateway, source-horizon — the last also now OWNS knowledge_source_pool.rs, which had no capability mapping at all and would have failed CI's changed-source coverage). Scope prose, code_basis digests, change_refs and account provenance all updated through the repo's own reconcile tool (transaction receipt .central/documentation-transactions/0ab02ce431a54fbb81fb140f92db4c57). Errors are back to exactly the 7 pre-existing main-debt entries; this change adds none. OPEN: (1) 1274 link absences remain, dominated by links addressing paths ABOVE the ingested root (297 'symbolon/...', 275 'submission-package/...', 234 '../section-rooms', 44 'working/', 31 'quilt/'); ingesting from the essay repo root instead of .../essay/symbolon would resolve most, and that is an owner call about what the corpus's link space is. (2) 11 named unaddressable files remain — READMEs, CANONICAL-INDEX, and 6 HISTORICAL-BRANCHES/DEVELOPMENT pages carrying a record signature with no id: real authoring gaps, now visible instead of counted. (3) 24 declared source_ids name no source page. (4) The work sits UNCOMMITTED on ai-kit main, which advanced 3341c2b->49bff02 under this session; it rebuilt and retested clean on the new base but wants a branch and a PR. (5) The 7 pre-existing product-ground errors still want their own reconciliation pass.
